ruling_text:
Jose Garcia v. Larry E. Meregillano, et al.

Plaintiff Garcia's Deem Admit RFAs (Set 3) against Defendant Meregillano is MOOT except for sanctions. Sanctions are awarded in the amount of $628.00 against Defendant Meregillano and his attorney of record, Law Offices of Marc E. Grossman, due within 30 days of this ruling.
